test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that uses the idiom correctly.

options.text: Trees shed their leaves under the weather.
She missed the exam as she felt under the weather.
Reena was walking on the lawn under the weather.

solution:
The correct answer is **She missed the exam as she felt under the weather. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is She missed the exam as she felt under the weather. 
 
• The idiom **U**nder the weather means feeling ill.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Under the weather. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Under the weather** means felling sick, ill or not well.
 
• **Examples **- ***I’m feeling a bit under the weather today***.
 
 
• ***I was feeling okay this morning, but no, I feel under the weather.***
